title: Discover and instrument your application services

blocks.content: Instrumentation Hub discovers the application services running on your cluster and lets you instrument them with one click. This guide follows the **Install Alloy on Kubernetes** guide (ihub-install-alloy-k8s): it assumes your collectors are installed and active, so discovered services are already flowing in. To begin, open the Instrumentation Hub landing page.
Go to the **Instrumentation Hub** landing page.
blocks.tooltip: Start here to see the monitoring capabilities available on your stack.

blocks.content: You're on the Instrumentation Hub landing page, which shows cards for the monitoring capabilities available on your stack.
Next, open the application services view, choose the services you want to monitor, and instrument them.

blocks.title: Discover and instrument your application services

blocks.content: On the Application services card, click **View & instrument services**.
blocks.tooltip: Open the list of services discovered on your cluster so you can choose which to instrument.

blocks.content: Land on the application monitoring view, where discovered services are listed.
blocks.tooltip: Review the services your active collectors have discovered before instrumenting any of them.

blocks.content: Select the services you want to instrument. Use the selection checkbox in the table header for bulk options, or tick individual services. Choose these yourself: instrumenting changes what is monitored on your stack.
blocks.tooltip: Pick the services yourself — instrumenting changes what is monitored on your stack.

blocks.content: Click **Instrument selected** to instrument the services you chose.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm your selection to start instrumenting the chosen services.

blocks.content: Watch the services list: the services you selected show a pending instrumentation status, then change to instrumented as the change rolls out.
blocks.tooltip: Your selected services move from pending to instrumented as the change rolls out.

blocks.content: You instrumented your selected application services. Success looks like each service you selected showing an instrumenting (pending) status in the services table, then switching to instrumented as the change rolls out.
